audit.whatIsWrong: Chart read Skill, Kennen, Kennen, Skill, Skill, Kennen, Kennen on both layers. It disagreed with the packet chart, with this page's own whys (Level 3 skill, Levels 4-5 yours, Level 6 his, 2+ items yours) and with the already-audited mirror.
audit.why: The mirror (kennen__wukong) fixed rows 3, 4, 5 and 7 as an atomic group; restating those from this side rather than re-deriving them.
audit.corrected: Level 3 = Skill, Levels 4-5 = Wukong, Level 6 = Kennen, 2+ items = Wukong, as matched pairs on both layers with ratings following.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[3], [4] and [6] whys were generic template text that did not name a spike.
audit.why: The real spikes are the pre-6 window on a spent Lightning Rush, the level 6 Maelstrom + Lightning Rush dive, and the two-item side lane where he cannot combo alone.
audit.corrected: All three rewritten with the mechanic and the number.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page said Wukong's R 'cancels his Maelstrom channel' in whys[6], spikes[3].text, breakdown late/content late and wants.you[2].
audit.why: Slicing Maelstrom carries no channel flag in the kit and Riot's text — 'summons a storm that strikes at nearby enemy champions' — describes no channel. Telling a player a knockup cuts the ult short is a fact they will act on in a fight and lose it. What a knockup genuinely does is displace him out of position while the 550-radius storm keeps ticking. Also missing: Lightning Rush applies a Mark of the Storm, so it is not only an escape — it can be the third mark that stuns you.
audit.corrected: Cancel claims replaced with displacement. Lightning Rush described as escape AND mark source, with its 10s rank-1 cooldown and 80 mana cost.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns carried placeholder entries and no numbers.
audit.why: Thundering Shuriken falls from 7s to 4s as he ranks it, which is why the poke gets unbearable; Slicing Maelstrom is a flat 120s at every rank, so a dodged ult is a two-minute window.
audit.corrected: Real cooldowns written into breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d and report[5].t.

audit.whatIsWrong: Trade rules used generic 'E'/'Q' and did not key the disengage to anything.
audit.why: The clone should come out before his third mark, which is the actual losing moment.
audit.corrected: tradeGood, dosFull[1].d, breakdown.trading, report[3].t rewritten in-band with real names.

notes: The biggest fix here is the repeated claim that Wukong's R cancels Slicing Maelstrom as a channel. The kit gives R no channel flag and Riot's text describes none — I replaced 'cancel' with displacement everywhere it appeared and marked the point Medium confidence rather than asserting the opposite outcome. If someone can confirm from the Wiki whether a knockup interrupts Slicing Maelstrom, that single answer would upgrade four strings on this page. Level chart restated from the mirror, not re-derived. No Wukong cooldowns used — ownerKit was null in this brief.
